Third-party dictionary content is for reference and does not represent LUMI’s views. Some content may be filtered. Mainland Chinese dictionary suggestions are welcome and will be reviewed.

LUMI has made efforts to find and prioritize open-source dictionaries contributed by mainland Chinese communities. The primary Chinese dictionary uses the chinese-xinhua community project; optional dictionaries from other sources are also available. See each dictionary for its sources and license.

If you know of suitable mainland Chinese dictionary resources, please share the project link, data sources, and licensing information. We will prioritize reviewing them and add resources after checking authorization, content quality, and compatibility.

Third-party content is for learning and reading reference and may contain errors, outdated information, or regional usage differences. Entries, examples, and quotations do not represent LUMI’s views. LUMI builds indexes, reformats data, converts Chinese characters where appropriate, and filters selected entries, senses, and examples using content rules. Displayed content may differ from the original.

This notice does not change the rights granted by each dictionary license. Filtering may miss content or affect legitimate entries. Please report errors, rights issues, inappropriate content, or incorrect filtering.
